==Usage==
A reversed-order version of {{Tl|StoryCite}}, only to be used for certain scenarios such as toy citations.

There are three ways to use this template, depending on what link you want the individual toy to use:
#Linking to another Wookieepedia article:
#*<nowiki>{{SimpleToyCite|parent=The Walt Disney Company|item=Jedi|itext=Formatted Name}}</nowiki>
#*{{SimpleToyCite|parent=The Walt Disney Company|item=Jedi|itext=Formatted Name}}
#Linking to another website:
#*<nowiki>{{SimpleToyCite|parent=The Walt Disney Company|pack=Jedi|url=https://www.google.com}}</nowiki>
#*{{SimpleToyCite|parent=The Walt Disney Company|pack=Jedi|url=https://www.google.com}}
#No link:
#*<nowiki>{{SimpleToyCite|parent=Master Replicas|nolink=Mara Jade Lightsaber}}</nowiki>
#*{{SimpleToyCite|parent=Master Replicas|nolink=Mara Jade Lightsaber}}
